widget.solution:
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def plot_rebased(days, a, b, names):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    for prices, name in zip([a, b], names):
        rebased = [p / prices[0] * 100 for p in prices]
        ax.plot(days, rebased, label=name)
    ax.set_ylabel("Rebased (day 1 = 100)")
    ax.legend()
    return ax

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def returns_scatter(closes_a, closes_b):
    ra = [b / a - 1 for a, b in zip(closes_a, closes_a[1:])]
    rb = [b / a - 1 for a, b in zip(closes_b, closes_b[1:])]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.scatter(ra, rb)  # one point per day: ra across, rb up
    ax.set_xlabel("Harbour daily return")
    ax.set_ylabel("Kestrel daily return")
    return ax
